msg: It seems like there could be multiple patterns, but in the end I seemed to do OK by choosing the same gnome until the value went down, then switching to the other gnome. For example, I started with dark purple pointy hat, when his yield got low I switched to his partner, grey roundy hat. Same for the other pair but it took a mo to figure who was best first out of pinkyred small hat and brown pointy hat, so you'll have to test that for yourself if you like. Also, don't be too quick! I missed a few by selecting my gnome then hitting space immediately, before the basket appeared. Ironically that meant I got a "too slow!" screen, so yeah, be quick but not too quick!
